domain_analysis.scope: Interior NC wainscot panel stain/clear for 3 panel styles (flat, raised, recessed)
key_differences_from_wood_wall_stain: Always H1 height (32-42 inches) — no height modifier, no access equipment
Brush is default (detail work at low height) vs spray default for walls
Protection: floor_perimeter + wall_above (simpler than wall's floor_full + ceiling_edge + trim_mask)
Comfortable kneeling/stooping position — no fatigue penalty
Cap rail excluded — routed to SF_TRIM_NC_STAIN
Production rates similar to wood wall at H1

key_rates.stain_brush_wipe: 60 SF/hr — same as wood wall (similar SF surface, no height penalty)
key_rates.stain_roll_wipe: 100 SF/hr — good for flat panel areas

risk_notes.topic: Stain pooling in raised panel profiles
risk_notes.risk: Stain pools in raised panel detail edges creating dark lines at profile transitions
risk_notes.mitigation: Careful wipe technique at profile transitions. panel_style 1.25x accounts for time.
